description: Adaptive Surface 0.9.4 keeps one searchable item, loads selected baked and newly learned HD materials through one enabled per-world ZIP, and publishes staged changes only after the Hytale server exits on Windows.
changes: Mark material helper items with custom ItemQuality ZAS_Internal (HideFromSearch=true) and Variant=true; preserve state IDs and leave the main Adaptive Surface item searchable.
Persist material requests, merge baked P and learned Q entries into the selected world pack, and disable the obsolete separate learned pack.
Prepare next-start.zip outside active asset paths during play; launch a small bundled javaw companion at shutdown to atomically replace the ZIP after server exit releases its file lock.
Cancel placement and notify the player when the clicked block has a copyable material that is not yet preloaded, rather than saving a stone fallback.
Keep selected-block interaction resolution and topology/material persistence from 0.9.3.
advantages: User confirmed creative inventory and new-material issues resolved in the installed 0.9.4 release
No live atlas rebuild or runtime asset registration
One active world pack; helper items excluded from ordinary creative search
Future material requests survive to later starts
disadvantages: New material first encountered while playing still requires leaving and reopening the world
Forced termination can delay pack publication; persisted requests allow recovery
Final client behavior was user-reported, not captured by instrumented client tests
test_results: Offline Gradle build and 12,137 assertions passed; asset and shared-atlas validators passed
Installed user save: 63 active HD materials and 5,308,416 texture pixels; Rock_Calcite_Brick present; 63 helpers use hidden quality
Three isolated full QUICHE server boots/shutdowns exited 0: 63, 64, then 65 active appearances; native asset check found exactly one main item and hidden helpers
External cube fixture learned a Q token and loaded its texture from the same active world ZIP on the next start; publisher output hash matched staged ZIP
User confirmed both reported issues resolved after testing the installed release

metrics.reliability: User-confirmed visual result plus three successful isolated full-server startup/shutdown cycles
metrics.performance: 63 active HD materials, 5,308,416 texture pixels in installed save
